question: Batch 16 (2026-11-11, hardening phase ordered after a red-team review) for the Pulse Check video pipeline (Python; produces a 60-70 s Bitcoin news medley of other channels' clips; nothing is published; a drop goes to a private Telegram approval chat). PRINCIPLE: FAIL CLOSED. (A) pipeline/release_auth.py is now the ONE authorisation for 'may this exact file be sent as passing': a versioned exact gate inventory per format (REQUIRED rows decide release and must be exactly 'PASS' with evidence executed=True, samples>=1; MONITORING rows must be present with an exact verdict but do not decide; an enumerated non-blocking row; any other row, a missing row or a verdict outside PASS/FAIL/HOLD/SKIPPED/LIMITED is a blocker); run_fresh writes rows with exact verdicts + notes + evidence + the sha256 of the files the gates measured, and writes ATTESTATION.json LAST (after provenance; holds anywhere => HOLD; executed code compared with the LAUNCH revision; modules loaded from another checkout flagged); authorise() re-checks rows, the verification pack (complete + built with vision), the run end state, and re-hashes every bound file (both finals, EDL, both manifests, GATE_REPORT, VERIFICATION, contact sheets); telegram.deliver_run sends nothing unless authorised, builds and size-checks every payload before the first send, checks each file's digest again right before sending it, checkpoints every message (resume without duplicates; an unknown outcome is never resent; a complete drop is never repeated), never puts the bot token in an error, and refuses a headline whose numbers the video does not say; the legacy send_telegram_preview path is removed; replays are attested but never deliverable. verify_pack: strict panel (every vision model answers every checklist line with ok True), zero shots / zero cuts asked = FAIL, vision off = V1 SKIPPED, a partial sheet is no sheet, stale frames never reused. Law L-c amended: the acoustic proof that overrules a dissenting edge reading is measured on the FINAL file's audio (gain removed), never on the prepared clip; edge_word_fidelity refuses an alignment that leaves a word frame uncompared. G18: canonical units/signs kept ('5 percent' != '5 dollars', '-5%' != '+5%'; only 'dollars' after a number is tolerated, whisper's '$' habit); a repeat-only difference is adjudicated by the audio (span_matches) instead of being deleted. (21:10 order) pipeline/canon.py is the one canonical text form; every comparison site routes through it (a grep test fails ad-hoc normalisers); backtest.py replays saved days through selection; preflight.py runs before run_fresh in the wrapper; wrapper exit codes (no exit 0 without a delivery), lock fd never inherited by children. FIND: any path by which a video that did not pass, or bytes other than the attested ones, can still be sent as passing; any fail-open branch (missing / empty / mistyped evidence treated as pass); any test that does not test what it claims (vacuous assertions); regressions in the canonical form that make different words equal (numbers, units, signs, negation, names) or the same words unequal; anything that crashes instead of holding. At most 8 findings, each with quoted evidence (file:line), severity, and a concrete fix. (This chunk: B_canon_sites of the batch; judge only what is in it.)
